detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:03. The shot begins from <Picture 3>: a medium shot on <Subject 1> down on the dusty boards below the corner, bare-headed, the bottle-green velvet showing at his open overcoat, his head a quarter of the frame's height in the CENTRE, the peeled yellow plaster and its blood-red word "RACHE" on the wall above him. The camera is on the boards below the corner, level with Holmes's lowered shoulder and two yards from him, a 50mm lens turned on him and the floor. The peeled plaster and its word stand on the wall above. At the first frame Holmes is down on the dusty boards below the corner, bare-headed, the bottle-green velvet showing at his open overcoat. The camera pushes a hand's breadth in over the dust as <Subject 1> lowers himself onto his forearms over the boards, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 his head turns along the skirting, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:03 while his head turns along the skirting.
[Shot 2] From 00:03 to 00:07. At 00:03 the shot cuts to an insert on the dusty boards at the skirting, beginning from <Picture 4>: a steel tape measure run out flat along two boards and a large round magnifying glass laid beside it, a thin ink-stained hand at the frame's edge; only what <Picture 4> shows is in frame. The camera is above the boards at the skirting, pointing straight down, a forearm above the floor, a 50mm lens turned on the tape and the glass. The match light falls across them from the LEFT. At the first frame A steel tape measure is run out flat along two stripped boards at the skirting, its figures small and black along the edge, a large round magnifying glass lying beside it, the glass's brass rim bright, its lens clear over the grain, a thin ink-stained hand resting at the frame's edge. The camera pushes straight in on the glass as the tape runs a hand's breadth further along the boards, from 00:03 to 00:07.
